name: entertainer

feature.name: by popular demand
desc: You can always find a place to perform, usually in an inn or tavern but possibly with a circus, a theater, or even a noble’s court. At such a place, you receive free lodging and food of a modest or comfortable standard (depending on the quality of the establishment), as long as you perform each night. In addition, your performance makes you something of a local figure.

lore:
Behold the Entertainer, a migratory soul thriving wherever a hearth flickers or a crowd gathers. Their "ecology" is the public square; they are social catalysts who transform a mundane tavern into a sanctuary of myth. Like the lyrebird, they possess an uncanny ability to mimic the rhythms of their surroundings, adapting their plumage—be it silk or homespun—to suit the whims of their patrons.

In behavior, they are keen observers of the humanoid psyche. They do not merely perform; they dissect the room, sensing the precise tension required to draw a tear or ignite a riot of laughter. While they appear gregarious, theirs is a calculated magnetism. They feed on the shared energy of the audience, yet often remain apart from it, hidden behind a mask of greasepaint or song. To the Entertainer, the world is a stage, and every interaction is a rehearsal for the soul.
